jobs.occupation: Student Activity - Technology Analyst for Physical AI, Honda R&D Europe (Deutschland) GmbH (Wertpapieranalyst/in)
jobs.description: Topic This position involves investigating and evaluating emerging trends and technologies in Physical AI, with a focus on the interaction between artificial intelligence, robotics, and other intelligent physical systems. Particular attention will be given to how the interaction and coordination of these systems can enhance and expand production capabilities. Background Physical AI is one of the key technology drivers for the factory of the future, enabling intelligent robots, adaptive machines, and autonomous systems capable of understanding and interacting with their environment. As an OEM, we continuously monitor scientific and industrial developments throughout Europe and beyond to identify promising technologies, establish collaborations, and derive future innovation strategies. Then we look forward to receiving your application.
